meta.notice: All measurements are SIMULATED for the demo. Thresholds are illustrative, not NASA limits.

vitals.label: Heart Rate
vitals.countermeasure: Rest and do guided breathing. Notify the flight surgeon if it stays out of range.
vitals.threshold_source: Illustrative prototype value (general adult clinical range) - NOT a NASA limit

vitals.label: Systolic Blood Pressure
vitals.countermeasure: Drink 500 ml of water and re-measure in 15 minutes.
vitals.threshold_source: Illustrative prototype value (general adult clinical range) - NOT a NASA limit

vitals.label: Diastolic Blood Pressure
vitals.countermeasure: Drink 500 ml of water and re-measure in 15 minutes.
vitals.threshold_source: Illustrative prototype value (general adult clinical range) - NOT a NASA limit

vitals.label: Blood Glucose
vitals.countermeasure: Check the last meal. Take a standard energy ration if low. Notify the flight surgeon if critical.
vitals.threshold_source: Illustrative prototype value (general adult clinical range) - NOT a NASA limit

vitals.label: Body Temperature
vitals.countermeasure: Thermal rest, hydration, and check the radiation shielding status.
vitals.threshold_source: Illustrative prototype value (general adult clinical range) - NOT a NASA limit

vitals.label: Sleep Duration
vitals.countermeasure: Dim the lights and do 10 min of guided breathing.
vitals.threshold_source: Illustrative prototype value (7+ hours is the usual adult target) - NOT a NASA limit

vitals.label: Bone-Loss Prevention Exercise
vitals.countermeasure: Do 30 minutes of resistance exercise (ARED machine).
vitals.threshold_source: Illustrative prototype value from team blueprint - NOT a NASA limit

vitals.label: Daily Radiation Dose
vitals.countermeasure: Move to the shielded area and notify mission control.
vitals.threshold_source: Illustrative prototype value - to be calibrated with NASA / CSA radiation data
